::: {.sheet-main}

I am a partner and principal consultant at [January Advisors](https://www.januaryadvisors.com),
a data science firm that works with nonprofits and local governments. I lead a team of data
scientists working on housing, consumer debt, civic engagement, and demographic change.

I study how institutions and place produce inequality: who marries whom, who finishes school,
who gets sued and where.

Before January Advisors I co-directed research at CHILDREN AT RISK in Houston, leading
projects on education, child care, child health, and human trafficking in Texas. Earlier I
was a research associate at Pew Research Center in Washington, D.C., working on global
religious demography.
